scripts/oversized-continuation-rollback-.reason: Needs the sealed 411-file v0.7.4 source (PLIMSOLL_OVERSIZED_LEGACY_SOURCE) and its sha256 manifest (PLIMSOLL_OVERSIZED_INPUT_MANIFEST), which the CI checkout does not provide. Run locally: git worktree add --detach ../plimsoll-v074 v0.7.4, write {"files":{path:sha256}} for its 411 tracked files, then tsx scripts/oversized-continuation-rollback-proof.ts with both variables set (PASS on 2026-09-24, 0.6 s). Wiring it in CI needs a v0.7.4 setup step verified without that checkout's node_modules.

scripts/session-sync-upgrade-proof.ts.reason: Needs a v0.7.4 checkout (PLIMSOLL_V074_ROOT, default ../plimsoll-v074) and the private plimsoll-cloud source (PLIMSOLL_CLOUD_ROOT, default ../plimsoll-cloud: src/lib/delivery-ack.ts and src/lib/delivery-ack-response.ts), which the public CI checkout cannot fetch. The rule it proves (skippedStale counts every submitted row) also runs in CI as proof:delivery partial_acknowledgement_counts_rejected_rows_as_skipped_stale.

scripts/session-sync-liveness-proof.ts.reason: Host speed makes the 1M-row timing floor red on Studio3 (0.52 s); 4M rows passed at 1.93 s with a 14 ms health ping. SESSION_SYNC_LIVENESS_ROWS is optional and defaults to 1M, so this is a dated quarantine, not a missing CI input.

scripts/resource-proof/concurrency-proof.reason: Known red since d749a43 moved capture discovery to fs.opendirSync: the resource proof's directory observer wraps only fs.readdirSync, so it counts 0 entries and this proof's 2,000-entry floor fails. Lane eco-6hoxj.163.31 is repairing it; the fix also changes the no_change_constant_work receipt that the system-e2e support contract pins. The gate fails after the expiry date until the proof is repaired and wired or the quarantine is renewed in review.
